{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove rows where customer_age is -1 (sentinel for missing/invalid)
df_clean = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Verify 'converted' column
assert 'converted' in df_clean.columns, "Column 'converted' not found in data"
assert df_clean['converted'].isin([0, 1]).all(), "Column 'converted' contains values other than 0 and 1"

# Check age values
assert df_clean['customer_age'].min() >= 0, "Minimum age is still negative after filtering"
assert df_clean['customer_age'].max() <= 100, "Maximum age is greater than 100, possibly not in years"

# Filter for converted customers
df_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age_converted = df_converted['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted}")"}
